Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review because the PR changes posted G-code. I built and tested locally. The trial merge with upstream main `9e8e2135cd4cc580ccb91dfd2ec504c16c9950c7` was clean. I used no GitHub runner.

### Requested before merge

1. **Keep the original record indices when you filter the blank PARAMs.** `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:131` removes records before the driver makes `line_map` and `TraceBlock.record`. The app then indexes the original stream in `posting::viewer_map`. My test used the box stream and a script without `stockBlank = true`. The feed record had index 23. The returned map said 21, which was `Section { begin: true }`. Other moves can select an earlier position. This affects the other posts even when the blank option is off. Keep the original indices when you suppress the PARAM delivery. Add a test that checks the viewer map against the original stream.

2. **Refuse a cylinder blank with a negative K value.** `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:742` writes `stockTop - orgZ`, but the cylinder guard checks only the XY origin. A centred bar at Z -40..0 with `OriginZ = 5` posts `G1900 D50. L40. K-5.` with no warning. My test expected a reason comment and no blank block. It failed. The cited [FANUC manual, printed page 193](https://www.cnc.uk.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Manual-Guide-Milling-and-Turning-Manual.pdf#page=215) specifies a positive cutting allowance for this K word. Check its allowed range before you write the block. Add a test with the work origin above the top face.

### What looks good

- The new blank parameters reach only a script that declares the manifest flag.
- The normal tests cover box dimensions, inch output, a centred bar, unsupported stock, and unchanged output with the option off.
- No golden file changed. No UI file changed, so this review requires no UI screenshots.
- The PR adds no dependency and changes no build script or workflow.

### Local build and test results

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **PASS**, 395 steps, 0 failed. Post: 837 passed. App: 2,198 passed, 7 existing tests ignored.
- `fanuc_manual_guide_blank`: **PASS**, 6 tests.
- `stock_blank_stream`: **PASS**, 4 tests.
- `fanuc_aicc` from the stacked parent: **PASS**, 7 tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **PASS**.
- The Cargo manifest gives an existing unused dependency warning for `truck-polymesh`. It did not fail these commands.

### Extra suites run

The diff changes no fixture directory, test data, or importer. The extra fixture and importer rules select no additional suite.

I added two temporary review tests to `fanuc_manual_guide_blank`. Both failed on this head:

```text
review_filter_preserves_original_record_indices:
  left: Some(21)
 right: Some(23)
 mapped original record: Section { begin: true }

review_cylinder_above_top_origin_gets_a_refusal:
 G1900 D50. L40. K-5.
 expected: a reason comment and no G1900 block
```

I removed both temporary tests after the checks. They are the reproductions for findings 1 and 2.

### Mutations rerun by this review

- Removed the off-centre bar guard: `a_stock_the_block_cannot_describe_posts_a_comment_and_no_block` failed.
- Set the blank option's declared default and runtime fallback to true: `the_option_off_posts_the_same_program_as_a_stream_with_no_blank` failed.
- Restored the original script: all 6 `fanuc_manual_guide_blank` tests passed again. `git diff --exit-code` was clean.

### Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **PASS**, 204 steps, 0 failed. This review ran all reached steps locally. The gate checked the known failures #1950 and #2849. Both failed at the expected assertions.

### Notes

- The body still records the Robodrill kit confirmation as not exercised. Issue #2769 lists that confirmation in its completion conditions.
- The [manual, printed page 186](https://www.cnc.uk.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Manual-Guide-Milling-and-Turning-Manual.pdf#page=208), lists G20/G21 as ignored in background simulation for Series 30i. Explain this unit limit with the option.
- Existing source files above the size limit grew: `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs`. This is a non-blocking note.
- All review tests, mutations, and logs stayed local. I made no fix commit and pushed no change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Original record indices: the engine keeps every record and suppresses only blank parameter delivery. `suppressing_blank_params_keeps_original_line_and_trace_record_indices` checks both maps. `a_post_without_blank_params_keeps_the_viewer_on_the_original_moves` checks actual viewer positions against the original stream.
- Negative cylinder K: the post writes a reason comment and no blank block when the origin is above the top. `a_cylinder_with_the_origin_above_its_top_refuses_the_blank` pins this case.
- Series 30i unit limit: the option help explains that background simulation ignores G20/G21. `the_blank_option_explains_the_series_30i_simulation_unit_limit` pins the help text.

For each fix, reverting the production change made its test fail. Restoring the change made its test pass. The index mutation returned 21 instead of 23. The cylinder mutation emitted K-5.

The final quick gate passed all 395 steps. Post: 840 passed. App: 2,199 passed, 7 existing tests ignored.
Clippy passed for camcraft-app and camcraft-post, with all targets and warnings denied.
The first gate attempt failed on dependency metadata. The complete retry passed after local artifact cleanup with the compile cache disabled.

Needs changes before merge: the PR conflicts with current main.

This is a safety-tier review because the PR changes posted G-code. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

### Requested before merge

1. `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:47` and `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md:104`: reconcile this feature with merged PR #3307. A trial merge with main `b6a3e7c6b6dcbe7b1b8aa50de497848a0ba54801` conflicts in both files. Both branches define `manualGuideBlank`, with different stock parameter contracts. Keep one blank writer and one parameter contract. Preserve the index fix, negative-K guard, and unit help. Run the posting tests and gates on the combined result. The tests below do not validate that combined result.

### Earlier findings

- **Resolved: original record indices.** The engine now suppresses parameter delivery without removing records. `suppressing_blank_params_keeps_original_line_and_trace_record_indices` passed for both manifest settings. `a_post_without_blank_params_keeps_the_viewer_on_the_original_moves` passed against the original stream.
- **Resolved: negative cylinder K.** `a_cylinder_with_the_origin_above_its_top_refuses_the_blank` passed. Removing the new guard produced `G1900 D50. L40. K-5.` and failed the test.
- **Resolved: Series 30i unit help.** The option explains the background simulation unit limit. Its regression test passed.

### Local build and test results

The initial trial merge with main `7a626a7f5b91b7ed5d90ef006dede74e1ece3bbc` was clean. All results below refer to that trial merge. Main changed during validation. The later merge attempt found the conflicts above and was aborted without a manual resolution.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **FAIL**, 395 steps, 1 failed. Post: 840 passed. App: 2,201 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored.
- The failed suite was `camcraft-app --test machine`. It had 32 passed and 1 failed. The isolated retry failed too.

```text
thread 'a_kind_that_is_not_a_kind_refuses_at_the_door' (17540) panicked at crates/app/tests/machine.rs:606:30:
test result: FAILED. 32 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 0.08s
```

That test expected `router` to be refused. The reader accepted it. This was an inherited main failure, not a change from this PR. Main now fixes the stale assertion in commit `80e8891e0` through PR #3340. I did not count this resolved upstream failure as a second finding. The quick run above remains a failed run.

- `fanuc_manual_guide_blank`: **PASS**, 9 tests, including a complete run after restoring the mutations.
- `stock_blank_stream`: **PASS**, 5 tests, including a complete run after restoring the mutations.
- `fanuc_aicc` from the stacked parent: **PASS**, 7 tests in the quick gate.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **PASS**.
- The manifest gives an existing unused dependency warning for `truck-polymesh`. It did not fail the build or clippy.

### Extra suites run

The diff changes no fixture directory, test data, or importer. The extra fixture and importer rules select no additional suite. The focused post and app suites listed above ran again after the mutations. The failed machine test also ran alone.

### Mutations rerun by this review

Each mutation was temporary. Each named test failed with the mutation and passed after restoration.

- Removed the off-centre bar guard: `a_stock_the_block_cannot_describe_posts_a_comment_and_no_block` failed. The mutant wrote a G1900 block for an off-axis origin.
- Set the option default and runtime fallback to true: `the_option_off_posts_the_same_program_as_a_stream_with_no_blank` failed.
- Removed the negative-K guard: `a_cylinder_with_the_origin_above_its_top_refuses_the_blank` failed with K-5.

The restored post suite passed all 9 tests. The restored app suite passed all 5 tests. `git diff --exit-code` was clean.

### Heavy and light lanes

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **PASS**, 204 steps, 0 failed. This review ran every reached step locally. The known-failure checks for #1950 and #2849 failed at their expected assertions.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: **PASS**, 3 steps. The release build, `motion light: lib`, and `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` passed.
